ABOUT ABDUL BARI RAHMANI

A developer who cares about both the code and the experience.

I’m Abdul Bari Rahmani, a full-stack web developer focused on building practical digital products. I enjoy combining thoughtful UI, clean architecture and dependable backend development to create websites and applications that are fast, accessible and easy to evolve.

MY APPROACH

Build with purpose, not just with technology.

My current focus is full-stack web development with React.js and Django, while also working with JavaScript, Laravel and SaaS product architecture. I value clear communication, reusable code, responsive design, security and continuous learning.

I aim to keep projects understandable: clear components, sensible backend structure, responsive layouts, useful documentation and an honest development process.
